title: First-Class Mail volume: 2008 vs 2023 (billion pieces)

source.name: USPS Office of Inspector General -- historical mail volume analysis

notes: First-Class Mail volume -- the letters and bills category, USPS's traditional core product -- fell 50%, from 92 billion pieces in FY2008 to 46 billion in FY2023, even as the Postal Service's package business grew.
